newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Julius Nyerere wins Nigerian leadership prize.
newsitem.headline: Julius Nyerere wins Nigerian leadership prize.

text.p: Former Tanzanian president Julius Nyerere has been awarded the Zik Prize in Leadership named after Nigeria's first president Nnamdi Azikiwe, the organisers said on Tuesday.
The Public Policy Research and Analysis Centre, a non-governmental organisation in Nigeria, said Nyerere was decorated at a ceremony in the capital Abuja on Monday night.
There were two other winners, Nigerian economist Pius Okigbo and former government chief secretary Liman Ciroma.
Before the ceremony, Nyerere, who arrived in Nigeria from Ghana in Saturday, had audience with military ruler General Sani Abacha.
Abacha said the former Tanzanian president won the prize because of "his exemplary leadership style".
